verdict.line: You lose extended trades and all-ins from level 1 through roughly level 8 to Aatrox's healing and chain damage, but the 54.2% head-to-head rate over 3,132 games shows you win the game once anti-heal and armor stacking come online and you can land R in a skirmish.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's kit is built to win isolated fights — Deathbringer Stance empowers a periodic auto with bonus magic damage and a heal, and E (Umbral Dash) passively heals him whenever he damages you on top of letting him dash in or out — so he out-trades and out-sustains you in any 1-for-1 before you have armor and anti-heal. Malphite has no way to answer that sustain with damage alone; the matchup is won by denying him free damage windows, stacking armor for E (Ground Slam), and buying the healing-reduction items this build path is built around.

theirWindow.when: His W (Infernal Chains) lands on you
theirWindow.what: He will immediately follow with E (Umbral Dash) to close the gap and chain Q (The Darkin Blade) swings while his empowered passive auto heals him off a percentage of your max health. Do not stand inside 825 range of his W at all once you see his cast animation — walking out of that zone is cheaper than fighting out of it.

yourWindow.when: After he spends E (Umbral Dash) to engage or flee
yourWindow.what: Umbral Dash is only 9/8/7/6/5s on cooldown, but while it's down he has no gap-closer or escape. Step in with Q (Seismic Shard) to steal his movement speed, then pop W (Brutal Strikes) for the armor/AD buff and trade autos — he can't reset the fight until the dash comes back.

start.why: This measures a higher win rate (55.2% over 578 games) than the more popular Doran's Ring start, and the passive regen directly offsets Deathbringer Stance pokes and Darkin Blade swings during the 1-5 all-in window.

boots.why: The 80.5% pick rate and 55.2% win rate reflect that this matchup is almost entirely physical autoattack damage — Steelcaps directly blunts both his empowered Deathbringer Stance auto and his normal Q swings.

core.why: Rushing anti-heal first is the single highest-win-rate path in the data (65.6% over 186 games) specifically because Aatrox's passive, E, and R all heal him — this item is the direct answer to all three.
Gives you the HP and burn damage to actually win the extended skirmishes you were losing early, once the anti-heal is online.
Stacks a second source of grievous wounds and heavy armor against his physical damage, completing the sustain-shutdown plan OP.GG's own tip calls for.
Caps the build with cooldown reduction and more armor, feeding your E (Ground Slam) damage and letting you weather his attack speed in extended fights.

situational.when: the enemy team is loaded with burst magic damage and you need the shield proc to survive dives
you're ahead and want your ultimate back faster to follow up ganks and picks

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing Q (Seismic Shard) pokes during the windows when his E (Umbral Dash) is down and he can't dodge, giving you free burst damage in a matchup where you otherwise have none.

summoners.why: This is the standard pick at 71.3% with a 54.1% win rate, and it fits the plan of playing defensively through the hard early levels, holding waves, and Teleporting back in once your anti-heal and armor items make you the stronger champion in fights.

playing.title: Refuse extended trades levels 1-5
playing.detail: Aatrox has the solo-kill advantage in this window because of his healing passive and chain Q swings. Take short pokes and disengage rather than standing in extended autoattack trades.

playing.title: Hold cannon waves, don't force CS
playing.detail: If he's pushing you off the wave, let big minion waves go and reset rather than contesting CS into a sustain fight you lose.

playing.title: Trade only when E (Umbral Dash) is down
playing.detail: Without his dash he can neither close distance nor escape, so this is the only window where your Q (Seismic Shard) slow and W (Brutal Strikes) buff actually stick.

playing.title: Poke with E (Ground Slam) on cooldown
playing.detail: Ground Slam deals magic damage based on your Armor and slows his attack speed for free whenever he's in your 400 range — use it every 7 seconds rather than saving it, it doesn't require you to auto-trade into his sustain.

playing.title: Rush Bramble Vest first back
playing.detail: Per the measured data, anti-heal first item is the single biggest lever you have — it directly cuts his Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash, and R sustain.

playing.title: Save R (Unstoppable Force) for a clean pick
playing.detail: With a 130/115/100/80/80s cooldown early, don't burn it just to disengage — hold it to catch him out of position for a kill with your jungler, since isolated fights favor him but your burst all-in doesn't.

brief.patchCaveat: All build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1) — the tactical reasoning for why each choice works is this brief's own analysis, not part of the measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Manage your distance well to avoid Aatrox’s (E)-(Q) combo. Purchase items that reduce healing.
